name: B10-0445/2025 – After § 83 – Am 11
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the UN Climate Change Conference 2025 in Belém, Brazil (COP30)
part_text: 83a. Considers it unacceptable for the EU to conclude a trade agreement with the Mercosur countries that threatens the competitiveness and viability of EU agriculture; stresses that agricultural production in many Mercosur countries is significantly more harmful to the climate and environment than that carried out in the EU, due to lower sustainability standards and widespread deforestation; underlines that compliance with EU food production and climate standards by external partners cannot be effectively verified or enforced, and that such an agreement would create unfair competition for EU farmers and undermine the EU’s food security and environmental credibility; calls on the Council to reject the EU-Mercosur trade agreement during the voting process;
